title: tracking-api 502s when the WMS replays webhook events
symptom: tracking-api returns 502s and pods restart after the warehouse WMS replays a large batch of webhook events.
rootCause: Webhook ingestion ran synchronously inside the API pods; a 60k-event replay exhausted the Node event loop and failed health checks.
resolution: 1) Enable the ingestion queue (WEBHOOK_MODE=queue) so events go to SQS and are processed by tracking-worker. 2) Rate-limit the WMS webhook route to 200 req/s. 3) If a replay is in progress: scale tracking-worker to 6 replicas and keep API pods at minimum 4.
prevention: WMS team must announce replays in #beta-ops; alert on webhook queue depth over 10k.
